children.heading: In general
children.text: Before July 1, 2005, the Secretary shall establish consistent with this section requirements for prescription drug plans to ensure the effective coordination between a part D plan (as defined in paragraph (5)) and a State Pharmaceutical Assistance Program (as defined in subsection (b)) with respect to— for part D eligible individuals enrolled under both types of plans.
payment of premiums and coverage; and
payment for supplemental prescription drug benefits,

children.heading: Coordination elements
children.text: The requirements under paragraph (1) shall include requirements relating to coordination of each of the following: Such requirements shall be consistent with applicable law to safeguard the privacy of any individually identifiable beneficiary information.
Enrollment file sharing.
The processing of claims, including electronic processing.
Claims payment.
Claims reconciliation reports.
Application of the protection against high out-of-pocket expenditures under section 1395w–102(b)(4) of this title.
Other administrative processes specified by the Secretary.

children.heading: Use of lump sum per capita method
children.text: Such requirements shall include a method for the application by a part D plan of specified funding amounts from a State Pharmaceutical Assistance Program for enrolled individuals for supplemental prescription drug benefits.

children.heading: Consultation
children.text: In establishing requirements under this subsection, the Secretary shall consult with State Pharmaceutical Assistance Programs, MA organizations, States, pharmaceutical benefit managers, employers, representatives of part D eligible individuals, the data processing experts, pharmacists, pharmaceutical manufacturers, and other experts.

children.heading: Part D plan defined
children.text: For purposes of this section and section 1395w–134 of this title, the term “part D plan” means a prescription drug plan and an MA–PD plan.

tree.heading: State Pharmaceutical Assistance Program
tree.text: For purposes of this part, the term “State Pharmaceutical Assistance Program” means a State program—

children.text: which provides financial assistance for the purchase or provision of supplemental prescription drug coverage or benefits on behalf of part D eligible individuals;

which, in determining eligibility and the amount of assistance to part D eligible individuals under the Program, provides assistance to such individuals in all part D plans and does not discriminate based upon the part D plan in which the individual is enrolled; and
which satisfies the requirements of subsections (a) and (c).

children.heading: Medicare as primary payor
children.text: The requirements of this section shall not change or affect the primary payor status of a part D plan.

children.heading: Use of a single card
children.text: A card that is issued under section 1395w–104(b)(2)(A) of this title for use under a part D plan may also be used in connection with coverage of benefits provided under a State Pharmaceutical Assistance Program and, in such case, may contain an emblem or symbol indicating such connection.

children.heading: Other provisions
children.text: The provisions of section 1395w–134(c) of this title shall apply to the requirements under this section.

children.heading: Special treatment under out-of-pocket rule
children.text: In applying section 1395w–102(b)(4)(C)(ii) of this title, expenses incurred under a State Pharmaceutical Assistance Program may be counted toward the annual out-of-pocket threshold.

children.heading: Construction
children.text: Nothing in this section shall be construed as requiring a State Pharmaceutical Assistance Program to coordinate or provide financial assistance with respect to any part D plan.

tree.heading: Facilitation of transition and coordination with State Pharmaceutical Assistance Programs

children.heading: Transitional grant program
children.text: The Secretary shall provide payments to State Pharmaceutical Assistance Programs with an application approved under this subsection.

children.heading: Use of funds
children.text: Payments under this section may be used by a Program for any of the following:
Educating part D eligible individuals enrolled in the Program about the prescription drug coverage available through part D plans under this part.
Providing technical assistance, phone support, and counseling for such enrollees to facilitate selection and enrollment in such plans.
Other activities designed to promote the effective coordination of enrollment, coverage, and payment between such Program and such plans.

children.heading: Allocation of funds
children.text: Of the amount appropriated to carry out this subsection for a fiscal year, the Secretary shall allocate payments among Programs that have applications approved under paragraph (4) for such fiscal year in proportion to the number of enrollees enrolled in each such Program as of October 1, 2003.

children.heading: Application
children.text: No payments may be made under this subsection except pursuant to an application that is submitted and approved in a time, manner, and form specified by the Secretary.

children.heading: Funding
children.text: Out of any funds in the Treasury not otherwise appropriated, there are appropriated for each of fiscal years 2005 and 2006, $62,500,000 to carry out this subsection.
